meta.name: learning-planner
meta.description: Structure learning paths for game development. Use when planning what to learn, choosing courses, tracking learning progress, or connecting learning to building. Prevents tutorial hell and ensures learning serves the game.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划游戏开发学习路线,边学边做出游戏
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果学游戏开发时容易迷失方向,需要有人帮你梳理学习路径。
copy.tagline_en: Map out a game dev learning path and build as you learn
copy.fit_line_en: For you if learning game dev often feels aimless and you need a structured path toward building games.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把学习规划成「学一点儿→立刻动手做→撞到墙再学」的循环；要求每个学习阶段带原创小实践，并记录撞到的墙作为下一步目标，跟踪已解锁技能而非课程完成度。
howto.when: 当你说“我该学什么”“选哪门课”等，或提出“我需要学 X”、想把学习跟做游戏联系起来时触发。

say.text: 我想学 Godot，先学什么能做出玩家移动？
say.note: 按项目依赖顺序给出最小学习内容，并建议动手构建。

say.text: 我刚学完两个教程，但没做过原创项目，怎么办？
say.note: 提示你可能陷入教程地狱，让你先做最简单的原创小作品。

say.text: 帮我建一个学习阶段，带实践项目和完成信号。
say.note: 生成学习票，包含 1-2 小时的小实践和完成条件。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude structures learning as a cycle: learn just enough, attempt to build, hit a wall, then learn what the wall requires. It makes each learning phase include an original mini-practice, tracks walls hit as next targets, and logs unlocked skills instead of course completion.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say things like 'what should I learn' or 'which course', or state 'I need to learn X', or want to connect learning to building a game.

say_en.text: I want to learn Godot. What should I learn first to make player movement?
say_en.note: Gives the minimal next step based on project dependency and suggests building.

say_en.text: I just finished two tutorials but haven't built anything original. What now?
say_en.note: Flags tutorial hell and has you build an ugly tiny original thing.

say_en.text: Create a learning phase for me with a practice project and a done signal.
say_en.note: Generates a learning ticket with a 1-2 hour mini-build and completion condition.
